title: Schedule of Transaction Fees and Charging Allowances, Personal Credit Cards
content:
### What this schedule prices

Three charges on Personal Credit Cards are priced per transaction: the cash advance fee, quoted as a percentage of each advance with a floor in dollars; the foreign transaction fee, charged on each purchase made outside the United States or in a foreign currency; and, as an allowance rather than a charge, the tolerance by which a purchase may be authorized above the credit limit. The schedule also states the share of the credit limit that cash advances posted in one statement cycle may not exceed.

### Tier table

| Tier | Cash advance fee percentage | Smallest cash advance fee | Cash advance share of the limit per cycle | Foreign transaction fee | Over-limit tolerance |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | 5.0 percent | 10.00 USD | 20 percent | 3.0 percent | 0 percent |
| College Rewards Visa | 5.0 percent | 10.00 USD | 20 percent | 3.0 percent | 0 percent |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | 5.0 percent | 10.00 USD | 30 percent | 3.0 percent | 5 percent |
| Cash Rewards Visa | 5.0 percent | 10.00 USD | 30 percent | 3.0 percent | 5 percent |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | 5.0 percent | 10.00 USD | 30 percent | 0.0 percent | 10 percent |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | 5.0 percent | 10.00 USD | 40 percent | 0.0 percent | 10 percent |

### Notes on the columns

The cash advance fee percentage and its floor stand at 5.0 percent and 10.00 USD on every tier of Personal Credit Cards; what separates the tiers is how much cash may be drawn in a cycle, from 20 percent of the credit limit on the two entry tiers to 40 percent on Visa Infinite Private Client. The two tiers that carry no foreign transaction fee, quoted at 0.0 percent, are Travel Rewards Visa Signature and Visa Infinite Private Client; the other four charge 3.0 percent of the purchase. The over-limit tolerance rises with the tier, from 0 percent on Secured Visa and College Rewards Visa, through 5 percent, to 10 percent on the two highest tiers.
